extracted.intended_audience: Principal investigators, institutional grants administrators, and organizations applying for ONR BAA grants
extracted.subtask_description: Instructions and mandatory requirements for preparing and submitting grant/cooperative agreement applications in response to the Office of Naval Research (ONR) Broad Agency Announcement (BAA), including required forms, technical proposal content, budget justification, compliance certifications, and submission procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Field 16 – Executive Order 12372
rubrics_metrics.description: Is Application Subject to Review by State Executive Order 12372 Process?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choose “No.” Check “Program is Not Covered by Executive Order 12372.”

rubrics_metrics.name: Field 17 – Certification (SF424 Block 17)
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicant must check “I Agree” on SF424 (R&R) block 17 to certify to the list of certifications and that statements are true, complete and accurate; provide required assurances and comply with resulting terms if awarded.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: By signing you accept criminal/civil/administrative penalties for false statements (Title 18, U.S. Code, Section 1001). Financial Assistance General Certifications and Representations must also be completed in SAM.gov.

rubrics_metrics.name: Field 19 – Authorized Representative
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the email address entered by the grantee on the SF424 to create the EDA notification profile; must be the same person who signs the SF424.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the authorized representative is unable to sign, submit a letter of authorization signed by the authorized representative with the SF424 application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project Summary/Abstract content requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Project summary/abstract must identify the research problem and objectives, technical approaches, anticipated outcome if successful, and impact on DoD capabilities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use only standard QWERTY characters; spell out Greek/non-English letters/symbols; no graphics; one page or 4,000-character (including spaces) limit, whichever is less; do not include proprietary/confidential information; must be marked “Approved for Public Release.” Abstracts of funded projects will be posted on public DTIC.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fields 1 & 1a – Human Subject Use
rubrics_metrics.description: Each proposal must address human subject involvement by completing Fields 1 and 1a of the R&R Other Project Information form.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For activities meeting DoDI 3216.02 definition of research involving human subjects, applicants must submit required documentation under “Use of Human Subjects in Research” (Section F) prior to award.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fields 2 & 2a – Vertebrate Animal Use
rubrics_metrics.description: Each proposal must address vertebrate animal use protocols in Fields 2 and 2a of the R&R Other Project Information form.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If animals will be used, the Applicant must submit the documents described under “Use of Animals” (Section F).

rubrics_metrics.name: Fields 4a–4d – Environmental Compliance
rubrics_metrics.description: Address environmental compliance fields and indicate whether intended research will result in environmental impacts outside the laboratory and how compliance with environmental statutes/regulations will be ensured.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Federal agencies/recipients must comply with environmental planning/regulatory compliance (e.g., NEPA). Many ONR field research activities may fall under NEPA categorical exclusions; refer questions to the technical point of contact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Field 7 – Project Summary/Abstract form handling
rubrics_metrics.description: Leave Field 7 blank in the R&R Other Project Information form and complete the Form SF424 Project Abstract instead.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If an error occurs when leaving Block 7 blank, upload the Project Abstract.

rubrics_metrics.name: Field 8 – Project Narrative attachment and naming
rubrics_metrics.description: Attach the entire technical proposal as the Project Narrative to Field 8 of the R&R Other Project Information form as a single PDF file.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Click 'Add Attachment' and save the file name as “Technical Proposal” (typing in the box is prohibited). Describe the research including objective and approach, keeping in mind the evaluation criteria.

rubrics_metrics.name: Technical Proposal – Cover Page requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Cover page must include the words “Technical Proposal” and key administrative identifiers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include: (a) BAA Number N0001424SB001; (b) Title of Proposal; (c) Identity of prime offeror and complete list of subawards; (d) Technical contact (name, address, phone/fax, email); (e) Administrative/business contact (same details); (f) Proposed period of performance (base and any options).

rubrics_metrics.name: Technical Proposal – Table of Contents
rubrics_metrics.description: Include an alphabetical/numerical listing of sections within the proposal with corresponding page numbers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Technical Approach section
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe the scientific/technical concepts to be investigated and provide the complete research plan.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe what is innovative about the approach, compare to alternate approaches used by others in the field, and, if successful, describe results, new knowledge, or insights.

rubrics_metrics.name: Future Naval Relevance
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a description of potential Naval relevance and contributions of the effort to ONR’s specific mission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project Schedule and Milestones
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a summary of the schedule of events and milestones for the proposed work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reports required
rubrics_metrics.description: Identify reports typically required under a research effort.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sample reports include Technical and Financial Progress Reports and a Final Report. Note: grants do not include delivery of software, prototypes, or other hardware deliverables.

rubrics_metrics.name: Management Approach
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe the overall management approach and rationale for participation of key team members.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain planned relationships with subawardees/collaborators; this is a single PI award—if subawardees/collaborators exist, explain fit within single PI structure; briefly describe anticipated schedule if appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Principal Investigator Qualifications
rubrics_metrics.description: Discuss qualifications of the proposed Principal Investigator and any other key personnel.

rubrics_metrics.name: Offeror Responsibility information
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide information to assist ONR’s evaluation of the offeror's responsibility.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe adequate resources or ability to obtain them; ability to comply with grant conditions considering current commitments; performance history managing Federal awards and extent previously awarded amounts will be expended prior to future awards; record of integrity and business ethics; qualifications and eligibility under applicable laws; organization experience, accounting and operational controls, technical skills or ability to obtain them (property control systems, quality assurance, safety programs).

rubrics_metrics.name: Data Management Plan (DMP) – length and required contents
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a data management plan (no more than 2 pages) describing which data/software/materials will be shared and preserved, how, or why sharing/preservation is not possible or appropriate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include: types of data/software/materials to be produced; how data will be acquired; time/location of acquisition if pertinent; how data will be processed; file formats and naming conventions; QA/QC measures during collection/analysis/processing; dataset origin when using existing data; standards for data and metadata format/content; appropriate timeframe for preservation; justification balancing preservation value vs cost/administrative burden; statement that data cannot be made public when national security or controlled unclassified information concerns exist (cite DoD Instruction 5230.09).

rubrics_metrics.name: Field 9 – Bibliography & References
rubrics_metrics.description: Upload Bibliography/References Cited as a single PDF.

rubrics_metrics.name: Field 10 – Facilities & Other Resources
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe facilities available for performing the proposed research and any additional facilities the applicant proposes to acquire at its own expense.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicate government-owned facilities that will be used. Note additional equipment will not be provided unless research cannot be completed by other practical means.

rubrics_metrics.name: Field 11 – Equipment
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe any equipment available or proposed to be acquired at applicant expense, indicating government-owned equipment to be used.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Justify the need for each equipment item and provide vendor quotes. General-purpose equipment (e.g., personal computers) should not be requested unless used primarily or exclusively for the project; if proposed, explain integration into the program.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of Grants.gov Research & Related Budget Forms
rubrics_metrics.description: Offeror must use Grants.gov forms including the SF Research and Related (R&R) Budget Form from the application package template.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If options are proposed, provide pricing for option periods; failure to include option costs results in options not being included in award.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Justification attachment
rubrics_metrics.description: Include a separate PDF providing appropriate justification/supporting documentation for each element of cost proposed and link to current single audit report.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attach under Section K “Budget Justification” of the Research and Related Budget form.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget – Direct Labor
rubrics_metrics.description: Itemize individual labor categories or persons with associated labor hours and unburdened direct labor rates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide escalation rates for out years.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget – Administrative and Clerical Labor charging
rubrics_metrics.description: Administrative and clerical salaries are normally indirect costs and not directly charged.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Direct charging may be appropriate when a major project requires extensive administrative/clerical support significantly greater than routine; direct charging must be supported with a budget justification describing the major project and administrative/clerical work to be performed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget – Fringe Benefits and Indirect Costs
rubrics_metrics.description: Show rates and calculation of costs for each rate category (F&A, overhead, G&A, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If rates approved/negotiated by a Government agency, provide copy of memorandum/agreement. Entities without negotiated indirect cost rates may elect de minimis 10% of modified total direct costs or provide sufficient detail for allowability/allocability/reasonableness. If composite rates are used, provide calculations. See 2 CFR 200.414(f).

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget – Travel requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposed travel cost must include, for each trip, purpose, origin/destination (if known), approximate duration, number of travelers, and estimated cost per trip.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Costs must be justified based on organization’s historical average cost per trip or other reasonable basis and conform to applicable Federal cost principles. Offerors may include PI travel to attend peer reviews described in Section II.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget – Subawards/Subcontracts
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide description of work to be performed by subrecipient/subcontractor and a detailed cost proposal for each subaward using the R&R budget form.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include subrecipient name at top of budget justification. Subcontractor's cost proposal can be included with prime proposal, provided in a sealed envelope, or emailed directly to the Program Officer at time of prime submission. A proposal and supporting documentation must be received and reviewed before Government completes cost analysis and enters negotiations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget – Consultants
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide breakdown of consultant hours, hourly rate, other proposed consultant costs, and documentation supporting proposed consultant rate/cost.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include a copy of the signed Consulting Agreement or other documentation supporting the rate, and a copy of consultant’s proposed statement of work if not already identified in the prime proposal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget – Materials & Supplies
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide an itemized list of all proposed materials and supplies including quantities, unit prices, and basis for estimate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Basis could be quotes, prior purchases, catalog price lists, etc.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget – Recipient Acquired Equipment or Facilities
rubrics_metrics.description: If acquisition of equipment/facilities is proposed, provide justification and itemized list with basis for estimate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Allowable items normally limited to research equipment not already available. General-purpose equipment should not be requested unless used primarily/exclusively for the project; include statement indicating how each item will be integrated into the program or used as an integral part of research.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget – Other Direct Costs
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide an itemized list of all proposed other direct costs (e.g., graduate assistant tuition, laboratory fees, report and publication costs) and basis for estimates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conference/Workshop Funding restrictions
rubrics_metrics.description: If proposal requests funds for hosting/attending a conference/workshop/symposium, follow specific restrictions and requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ONR will not sponsor an ONR, Navy, or DoD event. Provide list of other sponsors and requested amounts. ONR funds generally may not be used to pay for food/beverages as a direct cost except in exceptional circumstances with factual support per OMB cost principles and Grants Officer determination. Specify how the event directly and programmatically relates to US Naval or Marine Corps S&T Plan, identify specific focus areas and desired outcomes (e.g., proceedings, journal articles, algorithms, tools, additional research), and provide technical/scientific objectives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fee/Profit unallowable under assistance agreements
rubrics_metrics.description: Fee/profit is unallowable under assistance agreements at either the prime or the subaward level.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fee/profit may be permitted on contracts issued by the prime awardee (not on assistance agreements).

rubrics_metrics.name: R&R Senior/Key Person Profile (Expanded) – required elements
rubrics_metrics.description: Complete the R&R Senior/Key Person Profile (Expanded) for all senior/key personnel including PD/PI and Co-PIs, whether or not their efforts are funded.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Collect degree type and year; current and pending support list with title/objectives, percentage per year devoted, total amount of support, sponsor name/address, period of performance; upload biosketch/CV/resume. Applications missing required information may be returned without further review; DoD may request further details before making final funding determination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research & Related Personal Data – demographic reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide demographic information for PD/PI and other identified Co-PIs in the Research & Related Personal Data form; name fields must be completed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provision of demographic information (gender, race, ethnicity, disability) is voluntary and used for statistical purposes only; it may be accessible to reviewers but will not be considered in evaluation. Applicants may select 'Do not wish to provide'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grants.gov electronic submission requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: ONR applicants shall submit applications online through Grants.gov; white papers for grants must NOT be submitted through Grants.gov but through FedConnect.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All attachments to grant applications submitted through Grants.gov must be in Adobe PDF. Workspace can be used to prepare and submit; Grants.gov recommends submitting at least 48 hours prior to close date.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grants.gov & SAM registration and timing
rubrics_metrics.description: Organizations must have an active SAM registration and Grants.gov account to apply online; SAM registrations may take additional time and must be renewed annually.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Begin registration well before submission deadlines. Detailed organization registration instructions available on Grants.gov.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grants.gov account profiles, EBiz POC and AOR roles
rubrics_metrics.description: Add an organizational profile to Grants.gov using the UEI; EBiz POC authorizes roles (including Authorized Organization Representative - AOR) which allows users to complete and submit applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: AOR role insertion serves as the electronic signature on submitted applications; the EBiz POC must authorize personnel who can make legally binding commitments on behalf of the organization.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grants.gov Workspace process and mandatory fields
rubrics_metrics.description: Create a Workspace to collaboratively prepare application; complete required forms and address mandatory fields.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Workspace progress bar shows application state; context-sensitive help is available. Mandatory fields marked with an asterisk must be completed. Complete SF-424 fields first because information transfers across forms. Submitting is via Sign and Submit button.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proof and timeliness of submission
rubrics_metrics.description: Proof of timely submission is the official date/time stamp generated by Grants.gov when application is received; applicants receive email acknowledgement and tracking number (GRANTXXXXXXXX).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applications received by Grants.gov after the established due date will be considered late and not considered for funding. Applicants using slow internet should allow sufficient time; contact Grants.gov Support (1-800-518-4726) and obtain a ticket number for issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recipient Qualifications (Grants Officer determination)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Grants Officer will determine recipient qualification prior to award per 32 CFR 22.415; grants/cooperative agreements are awarded only to qualified recipients.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To be qualified, a potential recipient must: (1) have management capability and adequate financial/technical resources to execute the program given available grant funds; (2) have a satisfactory record of executing such programs or activities; (3) have a satisfactory record of integrity and business ethics; and (4) be otherwise qualified and eligible under applicable laws/regulations. Applicants are requested to provide information to assist evaluation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of SAM designated integrity and performance system in responsibility determinations
rubrics_metrics.description: For federal awards with total federal share greater than the simplified acquisition threshold, the Federal awarding agency will review and consider information in the designated integrity and performance system accessible through SAM.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants may review and comment on information about themselves in the system; agencies will consider applicant comments and other information when making judgments about applicant integrity, ethics, and performance per 2 CFR 200.206.

rubrics_metrics.name: Federal Funding Accountability and Transparency Act (FFATA) reporting requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants must provide information describing processes and systems to comply with 2 CFR Part 170 reporting requirements for recipients reporting subawards and executive compensation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entities are required to meet reporting requirements unless an exception/exemption applies; refer to 2 CFR Part 170 (including Appendix A) for details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Financial Assistance Certifications and Representations requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants must submit the Federal Assistance Certifications Report attesting they will abide by listed laws/regulations and supplemental Section F.2.iv as applicable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submit applicable documentation such as SF-LLL Disclosure of Lobby Activities, disclosure of unpaid delinquent tax liability, or felony conviction under any Federal law as required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Certification regarding Restrictions on Lobbying
rubrics_metrics.description: Grant and cooperative agreement applicants seeking awards greater than specified thresholds must provide a certification of compliance with lobbying restrictions via SF424 (R&R) Block 17.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Certification attests no federal appropriated funds have/will be paid to influence federal officials in connection with awards. If non-federal funds are used to influence, applicant must submit SF-LLL. Language of this certification must be included in all subaward documents at all tiers. Submission of certification is a material representation under 31 U.S.C. 1352; failure to file may result in civil penalties between $10,000 and $100,000 per failure.
